semantics.points: Target v and TargetCounts v: the point set is Fin v = {0, ..., v-1}.  TargetAll v: every type V with [Fintype V], Fintype.card V = v, and an arbitrary [DecidableEq V] instance (the statement quantifies over both instances).
semantics.sqs: IsSQS B := (∀ X ∈ B, X.card = 4) ∧ ∀ T : Finset V, T.card = 3 → ∃! X, X ∈ B ∧ T ⊆ X.  B is a set of blocks (a repeated block would put each of its 3-subsets in two blocks).
semantics.derived_design: derivedBlocks B x := (B.filter (x ∈ ·)).image (·.erase x) = {X \ {x} : X ∈ B, x ∈ X} (Tan–Zhou B_x), the block set of the derived design on V \ {x}.
semantics.parallel_class: IsDerivedParallelClass B x P := P ⊆ derivedBlocks B x ∧ ∀ y ≠ x, ∃! T, T ∈ P ∧ y ∈ T.  By DEFINITION the blocks of P are derived blocks (so they avoid x) and partition V \ {x}.
semantics.resolution: IsDerivedResolution B x R := (∀ P ∈ R, IsDerivedParallelClass B x P) ∧ ∀ T ∈ derivedBlocks B x, ∃! P, P ∈ R ∧ T ∈ P.  R partitions B_x into parallel classes of V \ {x}.
semantics.rdsqs: IsRDSQS B := IsSQS B ∧ ∀ x : V, ∃ R, IsDerivedResolution B x R: the derived design at EVERY point x is resolvable (no orbit representative is assumed).
semantics.counts: TargetCounts v additionally states B.card = v(v-1)(v-2)/24 and, at every x, every derived block has 3 points and avoids x, (derivedBlocks B x).card = (v-1)(v-2)/6, and a resolution R with R.card = (v-2)/2 and P.card = (v-1)/3 for all P ∈ R.  These are DERIVED (RdsqsKernel.Counts: card_blocks_mul, derived_card_three, card_derived_mul, card_class_mul, card_resolution_mul) from IsSQS / IsDerivedResolution, not hypotheses.
semantics.witness: rdsqsV := blocks V dataV = Generic.blocksOf (seedTriples V dataV): all translates ({0} ∪ t) + a (a ∈ Fin V) of the triples t = tri V e = {e.1, e.2.1, e.2.2} mod V of the raw POINT 0 section dataV (rdsqsV_spec restates this with Finset.image).  The resolution at x for multiplier m is resAt V dataV m x = image of seedClasses V dataV under y ↦ m*y + x (Fin V arithmetic).  witnessV proves IsRDSQS rdsqsV and IsDerivedResolution rdsqsV x (resAt V dataV m x) for EVERY x : Fin V and every (m, m′) ∈ multsV.
semantics.binding: dataV is the raw certificate POINT 0 section copied verbatim in raw order by gen_lean.py (raw SHA-256 checked; replay step 2 regenerates it byte-identically); dataV_range (kernel) shows every number is below V, so no reduction modulo V occurs.  audit_binding.py (replay step 3) recomputes, from the pinned literal and exactly these definitions, the block set and resAt m x for all x and m, and checks: raw block lines pairwise distinct with set = rdsqsV; raw POINT x = resAt m_x x as a set of classes for the seed rule multiplier m_x ∈ multsV, class j of POINT x = image of class j of POINT 0 (order preserved).  The Lean theorems do not mention the raw file; the raw-to-object equality is this external stdlib audit.
semantics.not_hypotheses: The STS property of the seed, the class partitions, translation closure, multiplier invariance, and all counts are not hypotheses of any root: they are kernel evaluations (dataV_seedCheck, dataV_multCheck, dataV_shape, dataV_range by decide +kernel) fed to data-independent soundness theorems (seed_of_check, isRDSQS_of_check, resAt_of_check, Generic.isSQS_blocksOf, Generic.isDerivedResolution_affine, Counts.*).
